# id: # Common v1 obligations in corpus/v1/contracts.md apply to every row.

independent contract: For lo<=hi, result is the unique y in [lo,hi] equal to x when x is in the interval and to the nearest endpoint otherwise.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; mathematical signed 32-bit inputs; lo<=hi; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result is the greatest lower bound of the two unsigned 64-bit inputs.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result is the least upper bound of the two unsigned 64-bit inputs.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: For x!=INT32_MIN, result is the nonnegative integer with square x*x over mathematical integers.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; x!=INT32_MIN; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result is -1, 0, or 1 according to x's order relative to zero.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result is the unique 64-bit representative of a+b modulo 2^64.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result is the unique 64-bit representative of a*b modulo 2^64.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result is floor((a+b)/2) computed over mathematical naturals even when the sum exceeds UINT64_MAX.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Output bit i is input bit (i-(n mod 64)) mod 64 for every i<64.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; all shift counts including multiples of 64; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: The eight output bytes are the eight input bytes in reverse order.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result is the cardinality of {i<64 | input bit i is one}.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result is the number of set input bits modulo 2.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result divides both inputs, and every common divisor divides it; gcd(0,0)=0.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; unsigned 32-bit inputs; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result is the product of integers 1 through n modulo 2^64, with empty product 1.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; unsigned 32-bit n; no practical runtime bound claimed.

independent contract: Result is the representative modulo 2^64 of n*(n+1)/2 over mathematical naturals.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; unsigned 32-bit n; no practical runtime bound claimed.

independent contract: Result is base^exponent modulo 2^64, with exponent zero giving one.
platform and ownership obligations: SysV x86-64 callable ABI; unsigned 32-bit exponent; ordinary return-stack ownership.

independent contract: Result is the least n with bytes[n]=0; every byte before n is nonzero; the readable byte sequence is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Owned readable stable byte range through and including a terminating NUL; external libc calls if generated need separate contracts; readable page/extent obligations must cover any widened machine reads.

independent contract: Result is min(n,first zero index in the first n bytes), taking n if there is no zero; memory is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Owned readable stable n-byte range; nonwrapping extent; external libc contracts if generated; widened-read machine permission obligations remain explicit.

independent contract: Result's sign equals lexicographic order of the first n unsigned bytes of a and b; inputs are preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Two readable stable n-byte ranges; overlap allowed; nonwrapping extents; widened-read machine permissions and external dependencies remain obligations.

independent contract: Result is true iff both n-byte input sequences are equal; inputs are preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Two readable stable n-byte ranges; overlap allowed; nonwrapping extents; external dependencies and widened reads remain obligations.

independent contract: Result is the least i<n with bytes[i]=value, or SIZE_MAX if none; memory is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Readable stable n-byte range; nonwrapping extent; unsigned 8-bit value; external dependencies and widened reads remain obligations.

independent contract: Result is the sum of the mathematical input sequence modulo 2^32; input is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Readable stable n-element uint32 array, proper alignment, nonwrapping extent; SIMD/extra-read obligations remain explicit.

independent contract: For n>0, result belongs to the input sequence and is >= every input element; input is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Readable stable nonempty n-element uint32 array, proper alignment, nonwrapping extent.

independent contract: Result is the cardinality of {i<n | a[i]=0}; input is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Readable stable n-element uint32 array, proper alignment, nonwrapping extent.

independent contract: Result is the least i<n with a[i]=value, or SIZE_MAX if no such index exists; input is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Readable stable n-element uint32 array, proper alignment, nonwrapping extent.

independent contract: Output a[i] equals initial a[n-1-i] for i<n; every byte outside the array is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Exclusive writable/readable n-element uint32 array, aligned nonwrapping extent; no concurrent accesses.

independent contract: Every output element equals value, and every byte outside the destination array is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Exclusive writable n-element uint32 array, aligned nonwrapping extent; generated external calls require contracts.

independent contract: Destination sequence equals the initial source sequence; source and bytes outside destination are preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Disjoint source/destination n-element uint32 arrays; source readable stable, destination exclusive writable; aligned nonwrapping extents.

independent contract: Result is the sum over i<n of mathematical a[i]*b[i], modulo 2^64; inputs are preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Two readable stable n-element uint32 arrays; aligned nonwrapping extents; overlap allowed; SIMD semantics needed if generated.

independent contract: For every i<n, output a[i] equals sum of initial a[0..i] modulo 2^32; outside memory is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Exclusive readable/writable n-element uint32 array, aligned nonwrapping extent; no concurrent accesses.

independent contract: The four destination uint64 fields equal the respective initial source fields; source and bytes outside destination are preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Disjoint 32-byte struct objects with SysV layout, suitable alignment, source readable stable and destination exclusive writable; SIMD permissions remain obligations.

independent contract: Result is the sum of the four initial uint64 fields modulo 2^64; memory is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Readable stable 32-byte struct with SysV layout and alignment.

independent contract: If result!=SIZE_MAX it is an index<n holding key; SIZE_MAX iff key is absent; input is preserved.
platform and ownership obligations: Sorted nondecreasing readable stable n-element uint32 array; aligned nonwrapping extent.

independent contract: A successful operation returns the value immediately before its one atomic update; that update adds delta modulo 2^64 in a legal sequentially consistent concurrent history.
platform and ownership obligations: Naturally aligned live shared atomic uint64 object; authority/lifetime and x86-TSO refinement needed; uninterrupted arithmetic alone is insufficient.

independent contract: Returned value comes from a legal coherent acquire read; inter-thread synchronization is required only when the read observes a qualifying release or its release sequence.
platform and ownership obligations: Naturally aligned live shared atomic uint64 object; read authority/lifetime, coherence, source-to-machine ordering and x86-TSO refinement needed.

independent contract: One legal release atomic update sets the shared uint64 value; a qualifying acquire that reads from this release or its release sequence synchronizes according to the source memory model.
platform and ownership obligations: Naturally aligned live shared atomic uint64 object; write authority/lifetime, coherence, source-to-machine ordering and x86-TSO refinement needed.

independent contract: On successful return the caller exclusively owns the critical-section invariant, and acquisition has a legal linearization point changing unlocked zero to locked nonzero.
platform and ownership obligations: Live aligned shared atomic uint32 initialized as lock; invariant/ownership transfer, x86-TSO acquire ordering and scheduling fairness for any termination claim.

independent contract: Release relinquishes the caller's lock invariant and makes unlocked zero available after ordered publication of preceding critical-section writes.
platform and ownership obligations: Caller holds this lock exclusively; live aligned shared atomic uint32; invariant/ownership transfer and x86-TSO release ordering.

independent contract: Zero return observes a value different from expected through an acquire read; negative errno reports an unretried kernel error; EINTR/EAGAIN/spurious wakes trigger rechecking.
platform and ownership obligations: Linux x86-64 private futex ABI; live 4-byte-aligned shared atomic uint32; syscall/libc errno/TLS contracts, wait/wake/scheduler environment; no unconditional termination guarantee.

independent contract: Its history contributes exactly iterations atomic increments of one and no other shared writes; with two completed workers and no other writers final counter is initial+2*iterations modulo 2^64.
platform and ownership obligations: Live naturally aligned shared atomic uint64 with shared RMW authority; two workers' disjoint stacks, lifetime through joins, x86-TSO linearizability and legal interleavings; progress is separate.
